name: OKC_IMP_CONTRACT_ADDRS
description: Interface table for importing Contract Addresses in Fusion.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Import Batch Id, every batch of data being imported should be assigned a batch id.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a record within a batch, source system should populate this.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of row in the interface table, source system should leave this as null.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: Used by import utility to relate the record in interface table to the file row.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Code specifying the action for the import for e.g., INSERT, UPDATE or NULL. In the current release only INSERT is supported.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Used internally by the bulk import ODI program.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: FUSION_CONTRACT_ADDR_ID
columns.description: For successfully imported Contract Addresses, stores the Fusion Contract Address Id. This is intended to support reimport.

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Contract Address major version.

columns.name: EXT_SOURCE
columns.description: User or External key, to enable updates or deletes via bulk import or web services, if fusion primary key is not known.

columns.name: EXT_KEY
columns.description: See EXT_SOURCE

columns.name: CHR_ID
columns.description: Fusion Contract Header Id to which the address belongs.

columns.name: ADDRESS_SOURCE
columns.description: Type of address that is being stored. Currently only Fusion Party Site entity is supported as a valid address source. HZ_PARTY_SITES is the only supported value.

columns.name: ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Address Id (fusion key) of the address.

columns.name: HDR_EXT_SOURCE
columns.description: External key of the contract to which the address belongs. If a line is being created either the contract???s Fusion key or External key must be passed.

columns.name: HDR_EXT_KEY
columns.description: See HDR_EXT_SOURCE.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Type of contract entity whose address is being captured. Currently only Contract party addresses are stored in OKC_K_ADDRESSES table, therefore the only supported value is CONTRACT_PARTY.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Identifies the parent contract entity to which the address belongs. Should correspond to contract party. Either the fusion key or external key of the parent contract entity must be passed during create.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_EXT_SOURCE
columns.description: External key of the parent contract entity to which the address belongs.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_EXT_KEY
columns.description: See SOURCE_OBJECT_EXT_SOURCE.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Save the individual sys task id for each input csv file

columns.name: INTERNAL_ADDRS_OVN
columns.description: Internal OVN column
